name: Magicious

features.name: Expanding wild respin
features.description: Wilds expand and trigger a respin.

review:
Magicious is a 10-line magic-show slot with an expanding wild that triggers a respin. Wins pay both ways.

Thunderkick rates it Low volatility, with a 1,400x cap and a 96.0% RTP. Simple and easy to play.

The expanding wild triggers a respin, and both-ways wins help line up hits from either side. It's a tidy, low-volatility game with a stage-magic theme.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
